event_text: Thursday: Downdetector reports surge as fans arrive for the South Dakota volleyball tournament in Sioux Falls (about 4:30 PM Central)
notes: Converted from TicketNews's 'shortly after 4:30 p.m. Central'.

event_text: Thursday: most services reportedly restored (shortly before 6 PM Central)
notes: Converted from TicketNews. IsItDownRightNow shows outage-level reports until about 10:11 PM ET (c010).

event_text: Friday: doors set to open at the Caesars Superdome for the Usher and Chris Brown show (6 PM Central)
Downdetector complaints about Ticketmaster begin, mostly about the app
notes: Time as given by Hindustan Times, 8:33 PM ET.

event_text: Live Nation New Orleans posts that Ticketmaster is having a service outage and sends fans to the box office
notes: The post's exact time was not given; WBRZ's story was stamped 9:17 PM Central (10:17 PM ET) so it is earlier than that. Time here is approximate.

event_text: The Superdome posts video of Usher and Chris Brown on stage; the concert is no longer delayed (about 9 PM Central)
Superdome officials say Ticketmaster's problems are mostly resolved, with possible intermittent stops (about 9:30 PM Central)
notes: Converted from WWL; WDSU's 9:35 PM Central update also says the outage was temporarily resolved.
